t: A Visit to Roseraie de L’Hay | The Rose Journal
s: August 18, 2012 - When we were ready to leave, we went to the ticket stand to get information and buy something to bring home. The lady on duty spoke absolutely no English and my poor French only added to the confusion. We finally succeeded by using universal sign language and writing on an imaginary blackboard. She was a great sport and we still chuckle about this. On our trip back to Paris we laughed at ourselves and marveled about the garden. Our adventure at La Roseraie de L’Hay became one of the highlights of our Paris trip.

t: Roseraie du Val-de-Marne - Wikipedia
s: August 25, 2023 - Roseraie du Val-de-Marne or Roseraie de L'Haÿ is a rose garden in L'Haÿ-les-Roses, Val-de-Marne, France. Jules Gravereaux, who made his fortune in the Bon Marché department store in Paris, purchased a large property in L'Haÿ about 8 km south of Paris in 1892 and hired the famous landscape architect and horticulturalist Édouard André to lay out a garden containing 1600 roses.
